def longestSubstring(N, S):
    max_len = 0
    result = -1
    n = len(S)

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = S[i:j]
            len_sub = len(substring)

                continue
            first_occurrence = S.find(substring)
            second_occurrence = S.find(substring, first_occurrence + 1)

                break
